options.text: The emission of an alpha particle from a nucleus
The absorption of a gamma ray by a nucleus
The splitting of a large, unstable nucleus into two smaller nuclei, releasing energy
The joining of two small nuclei to form a larger one

questions.explanation: Nuclear fission is the splitting of a large, unstable nucleus (such as uranium-235 or plutonium-239) into two smaller daughter nuclei, along with the release of two or three neutrons and a large amount of energy. It is the process used in nuclear power stations and nuclear weapons.
